scope: copilot native user extension; new sessions; other harnesses unchanged

registration.response_rule: existing descriptor fields unchanged; additive native_extension_delivery boolean and any135 binding metadata tolerated
registration.identity_rule: PIJ_SESSION_ID/PIJ_SPAWN_ID when present must be corroborated as exact pre-bind/current process; manual native session+exact host process+pane resolves one stable seat; never newest-by-mtime; duplicate process mismatch refuses; same native-session reconnect retains address, user-driven new native session explicitly supersedes prior same-process seat through existing checked supersedes mechanism; mismatches otherwise refuse

claim.ownership: Copilot requires current native-extension attestation and never tmux fallback; pane claim gated by existing InteractionGate, failed observation is not permission
claim.bound: 0 or1 claims; serialized session consumer; client handles0 by bounded wait/backoff, not failure/busy-loop
claim.incarnation_rule: Native Copilot claims require native_session/pid/proc_start equal current attested descriptor; revalidate after waits before handing off. Other harness clients keep existing request compatibility. Missing/mismatched native tuple refuses explicitly; no fallback.

ack.grade: reader-read / native harness accepted, NOT model completed
ack.incarnation_rule: Copilot native ack verifies tuple against current attested descriptor AND job recipient against seat before terminal ack. Existing other-harness ack semantics retained. Delayed old consumer cannot ack replacement session work.

send.result: Pij receipt; no auto-forward on assistant event

rules: record Pij-to-native acceptance before daemon ack
abort old pending loop on native session shutdown/replacement
no direct artificial /clear or typed slash commands
private acceptance namespace under state-dir/native-extensions/copilot hashed from seat/native session/host incarnation; exact file layout unit-local
ambiguous or malformed claim stops affected receive work with diagnostic and no ack; outgoing tool remains usable; no new nack API

commands: Body messaging only: no new native command protocol. Copilot programmatic controls explicitly unsupported at producer/caller boundary with no legacy/tmux fallback; preserve other harness controls. Native user-driven new/resume/reload is lifecycle input, not remote control.
error: non-ok or non-JSON response preserves HTTP status and raw bounded body; capability missing/refused never activates alternate transport
semantics: normal accepted duplicate suppressed; crash-after-native-accept-before-record is explicitly ambiguous until native event/history proves outcome; never falsely exactly-once

test_ownership.daemon: registry/queue/capability/consent/drain native ownership and additive wire fixtures
test_ownership.extension: native SDK state machine with protocol fixture adapter and durable acceptance record
test_ownership.installation: safe setup and real-client harness that consumes actual source/artifacts

test_isolation: Manual means no Pij identity/preallocation variables or Copilot RPC flags; PIJ_RS_ADDR and PIJ_RS_STATE_DIR endpoint-only overrides and isolated HOME/COPILOT_HOME are permitted for smoke, never the live fleet.
